summary_zh: 泰國能源部長提議擴大全產業Direct PPA，過境輸電費初估每度1.40泰銖待ERC核定，製造業有望降低電力成本、紓解調價壓力。A3公布ISO 21423:2026，規範不同廠牌工業移動機器人的通訊與協同。BOI赴日路演，鎖定晶片、能源及新世代汽車投資。
summary_en: Thailand's energy minister proposes expanding Direct PPA to all industries (wheeling fee ~1.40 THB/kWh, pending ERC), easing power-cost pressure. A3 released ISO 21423:2026 for multi-vendor mobile robot interoperability. BOI courts Japanese chip, energy and auto investment.
